title: Preserve unrelated directories during E2E cleanup
outcome: Cleanup removes only the workspace allocated to its own test attempt.

acceptance.expected: An unrelated sentinel directory and its contents survive an invalid cleanup request.
acceptance.invariant: Cleanup requires valid ownership before any recursive deletion.

acceptance.expected: Ordinary, isolated and screenshot test modes use the same ownership boundary.
acceptance.invariant: An optional execution flag cannot disable ownership validation.

context.summary: Current source conditionally checks isolation before cleanup; reproduce without touching user data.

risk.reason: Destructive filesystem cleanup in a test harness.
